Latest Updates on New Hampshire EFA

Sourced from official and educational resources:

As a NH scholarship organization, and the sole administrator of the state’s broad-based Education Freedom Account program, CSF NH provides a platform from which thousands of parents of K-12 students can customize the learning experiences that best fit their children’s needs. Through CSF NH, families direct private and state education dollars, and choose from a list of more than 2,000 education providers and growing. Businesses donating to Children’s Scholarship Fund to fund scholarships for low- and middle-income K-12 children in New Hampshire can receive an 85% Education Tax Credit (ETC) from the State of New Hampshire against business profits tax (BPT) and business enterprise tax (BET).
